participation.context: Looked up from a blank leaf and did not leave the chair.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Came down the step with an older woman, looked up at the rooks, and crossed toward the lane. She did not speak.
participation.name: the lady of the parish

relations.note: he saw her from the window and did not go down

story.body: You saw her from the window and did not go down. You did not write on the leaf. You did not speak.

relations.note: he saw her from the window and did not go down

title: Saw a woman with dark eyes from the west window

description: No title, no number, no name

participation.context: Fair-copied the leaf alone and left it unnamed.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You wrote the one line fair. You did not add a title or a number or a name. You did not hand the leaf to anyone.

title: Fair-copied one line

participation.context: Spoke the four words alone, and stopped.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You said the four words. You did not go on, and you did not name anyone.

participation.context: Set a small cross in the margin and left the rest of the page empty.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You made the cross and wrote nothing under it.

title: Marked the day with a cross
